about_the_game:
Forklift Certified and a Manager?! Create product from next door via Minigames! These Turn into product which you distribute through the Tri-State area! Manage your Warehouse, upgrade and sort the products. Go through tons of different upgrades, factory sizes and earn Reputation with different Resellers! 
 
Don't forget to Ship your pants. 

Reputation: 
Earn Reputation with different resellers to earn more favor and money!  

Leveling System: 
Level up to 20+, earning different rewards along the way to help increate productivity!

Expanding: 
Three different types of warehouses for you to expand!

Minigames: 
Several different Minigames that allow you to make product to move through your warehouse!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (Version 21H1) or later is recommended.
  • Processor: Intel I3 2.3 GHz or better or Equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1050 or Better Direct X11 Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Become Forklift Certified and manage your factory in this simple Top-Down Management game. Ship It! Ship yourself to the world where you control the flow of product to the companies you can earn reputation with!
